title: GoalProfile
description: Formal schema for mission objectives active within an operating mode. Distinct from hard invariants (constraints != objectives).

goal_id.description: Unique identifier for the goal objective.

description.description: Operational intent and purpose of this goal.

mode.description: Operating mode where this goal is active (e.g., NORMAL, DEGRADED, RECOVERY).

priority_rank.description: Lexicographic priority rank within the operating mode. 1 is highest priority.

target_predicate.description: Formal boolean predicate or condition over WorldState representing goal satisfaction.

utility_metric.description: Quantitative metric name used to measure optimization progress toward this goal.

weight.description: Relative optimization weight when optimizing multiple non-conflicting objectives.

threshold_value.description: Target numeric threshold if direction is SATISFY_THRESHOLD or MAINTAIN_RANGE.

is_hard_constraint.description: Formal barrier: Goals cannot be hard constraints. Constraints != Objectives.
